_meta.description: Curated CLPS (Commercial Lunar Payload Services) landing sites. lat negative = south, lon positive = east (-180..180), planetocentric, Mean-Earth/polar-axis frame.
_meta.warning: Coordinates marked confidence=approximate are region centres from public sources, not post-landing telemetry. Mission dates and statuses change often: verify at https://www.nasa.gov/clps before presenting.
sources: Wikipedia mission pages (IM-1, IM-2, Blue Ghost M1, Peregrine, IM-3)
USGS / DLR / USRA LPSC abstracts for polar landing regions

sites.name: IM-1 Odysseus
sites.site: Near Malapert A crater (south polar region)
sites.outcome: Landed Feb 2024; tipped on its side after touchdown. First US soft landing since Apollo.

sites.name: IM-2 Athena
sites.outcome: Landed Mar 2025; came to rest on its side in a crater and ran out of power quickly after landing, so the mission was short.

sites.name: Griffin-1
sites.site: Western rim of Nobile crater region (south pole)
sites.outcome: Planned. Was the former VIPER delivery target region.

sites.name: IM-4
sites.outcome: Planned south-pole volatiles and resource prospecting mission.

sites.name: Blue Moon MK1
sites.outcome: Planned pathfinder; reference point taken from published connecting-ridge analyses. Exact touchdown point not public.

sites.name: Blue Ghost Mission 1
sites.outcome: Fully successful landing in Mar 2025; operated for a full lunar day and imaged the lunar sunset.

sites.name: Peregrine Mission One
sites.outcome: Launched Jan 2024 but a propellant leak ended the mission; it never landed.

sites.name: IM-3
sites.outcome: Planned; carries Lunar Vertex and the CADRE micro-rovers.

sites.name: Blue Ghost Mission 3
sites.outcome: Planned; Lunar-VISE investigation of silica-rich volcanic domes.

sites.name: Draper / ispace-U.S. (CP-12)
sites.outcome: Planned first NASA-contracted far-side delivery. Far side: no direct line of sight to Earth, ever.
